title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before setting up or running an outdoor eating area on a footpath or other public place.

laws.title: City of Busselton Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2026

sources.title: City of Busselton Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2026
sources.quote: A person shall not establish or conduct a facility without a permit.

sources.title: City of Busselton Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2026
sources.locator: cl 5.15, definition of facility, Gazette No. 41, 23 April 2026
sources.quote: facility means an outdoor eating facility or establishment on any part of a public place, but does not include such a facility or establishment on private land;
